owner_approval: User-directed in the active RFC 0018 workstream
reason: The first four completed held-out pairs all had zero tiny breakups in both methods, so D_s was zero for each pair and the positive-effect criteria could not pass on ties.
primary_endpoint: D_s = T_baseline,s - T_graph,s, where T is the count of actual splits whose smaller daughter area is below 7% of parent area over 200 Myr
revised_pass_conditions: Complete the 20 preregistered primary held-out seed pairs
No more than two of those 20 seeds have D_s < 0; D_s = 0 counts as non-worsening
At least 50 combined actual split events across the seed set
removed_pass_conditions: 95% paired seed-bootstrap interval entirely above zero
At least two seeds with D_s > 0
descriptive_reporting_retained: mean D_s and 95% paired seed-bootstrap interval using 10,000 whole-seed resamples and seed 180018
S_baseline - S_graph percentage-point difference when both shares are defined
relative share reduction when baseline share is positive
reporting: This criterion was selected after four held-out outcomes were observed. Label G2 as an amended analysis, include all four pairs, and do not describe the non-worsening threshold as preregistered. This owner-selected tolerance is not a geological calibration.
